text.tspan: Pi 40-pin header, re-exposed on top of the DigiAMP+ (pass-through).
Relay module, ONLY if CEC fails
D1 940 nm IR LED in ir_holder,
no transistor: about 13 mA, under a pin's 16 mA
Pin numbers are the header's physical pins; GPIO numbers are BCM. HDMI from the Pi to the projector carries CEC, the default power control.
Service pins: PIR 17, relay 27 and IR LED 16 (both CEC fallbacks). The TSOP38238 receiver (GPIO 23) is bench-only, to learn the remote.
GPIO 22 is the DigiAMP+ mute line.
